newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds follow lower Chicago close.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds follow lower Chicago close.

text.p: UK meals and feeds sellers mostly took their lead from lower Chicago soymeal futures overnight on Thursday.
Sellers were down as much as two stg a tonne but buyers were still not keen to follow.
"It's one of the worst weeks we have had this year," said one broker.
"I think it's time to put up the white flag," said another.
The only trade reported was for high protein soymeal on the east coast which fetched 228 stg a tonne ex-store for spot.
In the rest of the market rapemeal ex-mill Erith and resale was unchanged while the Liverpool and Hull mills were one stg up in the spot months and unchanged forward.
Corn gluten feed pellets were one stg down for first half April and unchanged forward while sunflower pellets and meal were unchanged.
